top_signals.title: Pentagon awards Raytheon up to $20.7 billion to nearly double AMRAAM production
top_signals.summary: The Defense Department has awarded Raytheon a multiyear contract worth up to $20.7 billion to build Advanced Medium-Range Air-to-Air Missiles, or AMRAAMs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia turns to insurers to spread the risk of AI build-out
top_signals.summary: World’s largest listed company looks for new ways to draw Wall Street deeper into the financing of the AI boom
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Stellantis Plans Temporary Halts at Several Plants in France
top_signals.summary: Stellantis NV said it will temporarily suspend operations at some plants in France next month amid a shortage of long-range electric-vehicle batteries and efforts to contain dealer inventories.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US crypto ETF inflows cool after $3.3B week but streaks hold
top_signals.summary: US spot crypto ETF inflows fell about 80% from Friday as Bitcoin, Ether, Solana and XRP funds attracted $64.8 million combined on Monday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: National Bank of Canada on the Economic Outlook
top_signals.summary: Stéfane Marion, Chief Economist & Strategist, National Bank of Canada, discusses Canada’s economic outlook, including growth, inflation, interest rates and the Canadian dollar, as evolving trade relationships, technological change and shifting investment flows reshape the economy, with Bloomberg’s Erik Hertzberg at the 2026 Bloomberg Canadian Finance Conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: U.S. Soldier Gets 70 Months in Prison for AT&T, Verizon Extortions
top_signals.summary: A U.S. Army soldier who pleaded guilty to hacking into multiple telecommunications companies and stealing mobile call and text metadata for more than 100 million AT&T customers in 2024 was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison today and ordered to pay nearly $300,000 in restitution to victims.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Bitget CEO ‘not very optimistic’ on recovering funds from $388M breach
top_signals.summary: Gracy Chen said she saw the 2025 Bybit hack as a “good reference point” for Bitget’s security breach, noting that only a small percentage of funds had been frozen or recovered.
